sentences.text: Nalam Rajasekhar, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 7

Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3679 of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 Cr.P.C., to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.116 of 2019, dated 07.06.2019, of Rentachintala Police Station, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 420, 120-B IPC and Sections 58 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State and perused the material placed on record.

The learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor submit that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the common order, dated 18.12.2019, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch.

Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the common order passed in Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch, following the said order and in terms thereof, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in F.I.R.No.116 of 2019, dated 07.06.2019, of Rentachintala Police Station, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 420, 120-B IPC and Sections 58 and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
The Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 18.12.2019, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch, to this order.
As a sequel, Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, shall stand disposed of as infructuous.
______________ D.RAMESH,J 07th September, 2020.
